_comment: Cursor agent hooks. Cursor-NATIVE event names only.
Cursor does not understand Claude Code's event names (UserPromptSubmit,
PostToolUse) in this file -- it maps those only when reading Claude's own
.claude/settings.json. A .cursor/hooks.json using them loads nothing at
all, silently. See .claude/settings.json for the Claude Code mirror,
which keeps the Claude-side names and matchers.
beforeSubmitPrompt -> Superagent's user-query logger (feeds the
Supertailor's friction analysis). Cursor sends the prompt under the
`prompt` key, which is what the script already reads. Disable via
workspace/_memory/config.yaml preferences.privacy.log_user_queries: false.
afterMCPExecution -> Superagent's email archive bridge. Every Gmail MCP
tool call is captured to workspace/_memory/email/ per
contracts/email-capture.md. Deliberately registered with NO matcher:
afterMCPExecution is not in Cursor's documented matcher list, and
Cursor's matcher target for MCP tools (MCP:<tool_name>) carries no
server name, so it cannot distinguish two servers exposing the same
tool. --kind=auto does the filtering script-side instead, on
mcp_server_name + tool_name. The bridge always exits 0 and never blocks
the parent tool call. Disable via workspace/_memory/config.yaml
preferences.privacy.archive_emails: false.
